notice: Public mechanics only. Code, model tests, native browser checks, player approval and hardware QA are different states. Local board edits do not commit GitHub. No private story or fake multiplayer.

tasks.title: Playable floating-city expedition

tasks.evidence: PR35: 23 model/boundary tests and 39 native browser checks; v0.1.0 published.
tasks.next: Preserve the playable loop while adding devices.

tasks.title: Private narrative / public engine boundary
tasks.acceptance: No private repository, manuscript, privileged key or hidden narrative loader in the public build.
tasks.evidence: PUBLIC_BUILD.md and local-import tests.
tasks.next: Review the allowlisted release files at every publication.

tasks.title: Immersive session and tracked rig

tasks.title: Quest controller movement and aiming
tasks.acceptance: Handed input, independent right-hand aim, left-stick motion, 30-degree snap turn, rail camera never forces head yaw.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Physical Quest 3 verification and performance profiling in X04/X05.

tasks.title: In-headset HUD and menus
tasks.acceptance: Health/ammo/objective panel, pause/atlas/archive panels, controller selection and Exit VR without removing headset.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Physical Quest 3 verification and performance profiling in X04/X05.

tasks.title: Physical Quest 3 acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Meta Quest Browser: two eyes, controller alignment, floor height, snap turn, menus, rails, suspension/re-entry; no sickness/comfort promise.
tasks.evidence: No physical Quest 3 run yet.
tasks.next: Collect headset browser version and full-session feedback.

tasks.title: Frame-time and rendering budget
tasks.acceptance: Measure sustained CPU/GPU frame times and memory on Quest 3, choose target refresh budget from measurements.
tasks.evidence: XR disables shadows and uses reduced framebuffer scale; no measured target yet.
tasks.next: Profile before adding more scene detail.

tasks.title: Comfort and room-scale calibration
tasks.acceptance: Seated height, handed locomotion, snap/smooth choice, comfort vignette and robust recenter/reference-reset handling.
tasks.evidence: Initial local-floor, snap turn and collision-limited room displacement implemented; full calibration is not.
tasks.next: Tune with physical testing, not desktop assumptions.

tasks.title: Two-hand climb and ledge acquisition
tasks.acceptance: Grip actual hand contacts, pull body with collision, transfer hands, release momentum and recover missed grabs.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented.
tasks.next: Build one climb wall in a mechanics yard.

tasks.title: Gliding from a rail or ledge
tasks.acceptance: Explicit deploy/cancel, carried release momentum, controllable descent, safe landing and comfort controls.
tasks.evidence: Rail release exists; gliding does not.
tasks.next: Prototype with one deterministic flight envelope.

tasks.title: Climb / rail / glide state transitions
tasks.acceptance: Continuous velocity between modes; no teleports or phantom grabs; recovery reachable after an intentional miss.
tasks.evidence: Design goal, not a finished traversal system.
tasks.next: Author and replay complete linked routes.

tasks.title: Readable branching rails and reward flow
tasks.acceptance: Fast/high/rich alternatives, deliberate backward exploration, visible receiver, repeatable compatible arrival states.
tasks.evidence: v0.3 adds Gale Market Loop and Prism Detour; 20 model jump/catch samples across four directions. Extensive branching worlds and player-rated route quality remain open.
tasks.next: Playtest full rides and missed transfers, then add compatible entry/exit assemblies rather than disconnected decorative rails.

tasks.title: Embodied reload and two-hand stabilization
tasks.acceptance: Tracked weapon alignment, magazine interaction, recoil, occlusion and left-handed options.
tasks.evidence: Ray aiming/button reload prototype only.
tasks.next: Keep current button reload as accessible fallback.

tasks.title: Distinct enemies and rail combat
tasks.acceptance: Readable threats, varied movement/attack patterns, fair cover and shooting while traversing.
tasks.evidence: v0.3 implements scout, heavy burst attacker and charged sentry, plus a passive target. Rich combat encounters remain in development.
tasks.next: Add one well-tested enemy behavior at a time.

tasks.title: Temporary tactical cover
tasks.acceptance: Constrained placement, costs, collision and no trapped player or unreachable route.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented.
tasks.next: Resolve locomotion before building dynamic obstacles.

tasks.title: Interiors, puzzles and exploration rewards
tasks.acceptance: Playable interior routes, puzzle state saves and rewards worth detouring for.
tasks.evidence: Current architecture is mostly exterior.
tasks.next: One building-sized exploration encounter.

tasks.title: Original visual and audio production
tasks.acceptance: Coherent architecture, readable surfaces, original audio and performance-budgeted assets.
tasks.evidence: v0.3 differentiates bazaar, greenhouse, foundry and spire silhouettes and four weapons. Original procedural art, not imported franchise assets.
tasks.next: Improve fidelity only within measured headset budgets.

tasks.title: Shared 3D world and rail editor
tasks.acceptance: Editable curves, anchors and geometry; validate reachability/clearance; save/export and exact playtest return.
tasks.evidence: Paper Delivery has a separate editor; not silently inherited by Aether Reach.
tasks.next: Define a world format before UI expansion.

tasks.title: Cloud levels and accounts
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated ownership, reviewed database policies, moderation and no client-only paid entitlements.
tasks.evidence: Local checkpoints only; no new cloud integration.
tasks.next: Separate security design and explicit service authorization.

tasks.title: Multiplayer authority and replication
tasks.acceptance: Server-owned simulation, anti-cheat boundaries, interpolation, latency tests and stable room ownership.
tasks.evidence: Single-player currently.
tasks.next: Design authoritative rooms and two-client traversal before competitive game modes. No local bot will be labeled a remote player.

tasks.title: Public Kanban / workbook planning
tasks.acceptance: Searchable tasks, explicit dependencies and gates, local editable statuses, portable export, matching workbook.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Update committed plan from verified work; browser edits remain local only.

tasks.title: Controller/XR preview publication
tasks.acceptance: Pass model, keyboard/touch regression, browser pad and XR-lifecycle tests; byte-verify deployed public files.
tasks.evidence: PR37 acceptance: 38 Node tests and 70 native/device-emulated browser checks, runs 34061735693 and 34061735714.
tasks.next: Read the published-file hash receipt in PR37 for deployment status. Physical hardware gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Four-weapon arsenal and sniper optic
tasks.acceptance: Mechanical differences in cadence, spread, magazine, range and recoil; actual 4x desktop field-of-view optic, not a crosshair picture.
tasks.evidence: 59 current Node checks include weapon definition, ray damage and transfer regressions. Native scope rendering has been inspected; full purchase/shot/save acceptance is tracked in PR39.
tasks.next: Inspect sniper, carbine and scattergun in actual screenshots; test LT and UI compatibility.

tasks.title: Earned-credit buy and upgrade economy
tasks.acceptance: Three world kiosks, meaningful starter loadout choice, per-weapon damage/reload tiers, shield upgrade; insufficient funds rejected. No real-money purchases.
tasks.evidence: Model purchases, caps, ammunition and save round trips pass. Native buy-upgrade-continue acceptance is tracked in PR39.
tasks.next: Verify keyboard/controller shop navigation and prevent double rewards or free refill exploits.

tasks.title: Exploration caches and enemy salvage
tasks.acceptance: Physical once-only crates and defeated-enemy drops; pickups supply credits/ammunition and selected unlocks; saves cannot repay an already collected crate.
tasks.evidence: Sanitized legacy-compatible kit extension and once-only reward tests pass. Native collection acceptance is tracked in PR39.
tasks.next: Tune rewards so exploring a longer route competes with rushing the objectives.

tasks.title: Free-look aimed jump-and-catch transfers
tasks.acceptance: Default independent sight while riding; two new adjacent detours, visible eligible rail target, physical release and a second catch action in range.
tasks.evidence: Four directions at five carried-state timings, plus 21 recorded-direction Gale release/delay fixtures and a bounded deliberate-input buffer. Native acceptance is tracked in PR39.
tasks.next: Review the receiving line and tolerance while moving; never substitute an instant scene teleport.

tasks.title: Distinct district and enemy silhouettes
tasks.acceptance: Original bazaar stalls, glass roof, industrial gantry/chimneys, solar arrays/beacon; scout rotors, armored heavy and sentry wind-up are visibly different.
tasks.evidence: Native render review identified and corrected blank sign lettering, the stretched rail HUD and phone-control overlap. Final visual acceptance is recorded in PR39.
tasks.next: Check visual readability, weapon framing, clutter and mobile HUD overlap.

tasks.title: Encounter balance and player feedback
tasks.acceptance: Replay the whole objective loop with varied loadouts; compare risk, ammunition demand, reward rate and alternate paths; retain the accessible foot route.
tasks.evidence: Not player-reviewed. Automated passage does not certify enjoyable combat.
tasks.next: Record user feedback and one small repeatable encounter per iteration.

tasks.title: Actual two-client rooms and replicated movement
tasks.acceptance: Two separate browser clients see distinct players, room join/leave, server-owned clock/state and tested latency recovery; no simulated lobby claims.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented. Current public demo is single-player.
tasks.next: Choose and authorize a backend explicitly; implement a minimal two-client movement slice.

tasks.title: Shared loot, buy authority and combat rules
tasks.acceptance: Server validates pickup ownership, currency, shot cadence, ammo and damage; duplicate claims and reconnect replay are rejected.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented. Local single-player saves are not secure multiplayer accounts.
tasks.next: Add authority tests before drops or shops are shared between players.

tasks.title: Magnified tracked weapon optic
tasks.acceptance: Render a real weapon-mounted magnified view within headset frame budget; do not zoom the whole tracked head/eye projection.
tasks.evidence: Desktop scope exists; the XR precision ray does not have a magnified optic.
tasks.next: Measure a render-target optic on real Quest 3 with independent head motion and readable lens.
